criterion: Provide paper-only risk kill switch and incident review with human-controlled reset; AI and UI actions cannot silently override halt.
test_result: 22 paper-risk and incident-review tests passed; Ruff and targeted mypy passed. Active latches block paper intents, non-human reset actors fail, human reset is journaled, and corrupt journals are refused.
evidence_scope: Synthetic paper account journal trips, attempted resets, human repair sign-off, and journal tampering.
operational_limits: Applies to the paper account journal and does not control a broker or live order route.
Sign-off SHA-256 is recorded but not verified by an external identity/signature provider.
Incident view is read-only; reset remains a human account-journal operation.
